title: A general extractor for coherent patterns across time-frequency measurements
abstract: arXiv:2602.20317v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Scientific discovery increasingly depends on finding meaningful patterns within volumes of sensor data too large for manual inspection. Existing time-frequency event extractors are often engineered or trained on manually labeled examples for each instrument, which can be laborious and difficult to adapt to new environments. To address this, we introduce TokEye, a reference-free method that learns a general criterion for coherent structure from heterogeneous fusion measurements. A model developed under this method, without retraining, can extract signals from various other fields including marine bioacoustics and wideband radar. It recovers 82.5\% of expert-annotated stellarator signals, detects 78\% of dolphin whistles, and identifies radar events with 81.5\% average precision across six benchmarks, while processing full experimental spectrograms in under one second on a GPU. translated_title: 一种跨时频测量的相干模式通用提取器
translated_abstract: 摘要：科学发现越来越依赖于在海量的传感器数据中寻找有意义的模式，而这些数据量之大已无法通过人工检查完成。现有的时频事件提取器通常是针对每种仪器进行工程设计，或在人工标注的样本上训练，这既费时费力，又难以适应新环境。为解决这一问题，我们提出了 TokEye，一种无需参考的方法，能够从异构聚变测量数据中学习相干结构的通用判据。基于该方法开发的模型无需重新训练，即可从包括海洋生物声学和宽带雷达在内的其他多个领域提取信号。在六项基准测试中，它恢复了 82.5% 的专家标注仿星器信号，检测出 78% 的海豚哨声，并以 81.5% 的平均精度识别雷达事件，同时在 GPU 上处理完整的实验频谱图耗时不到一秒。这种跨越不相关传感器和物理系统的迁移能力（原文此处截断）……
tldr: 提出了无需参考的通用时频相干模式提取器 TokEye，无需重新训练即可跨聚变诊断、海洋生物声学和宽带雷达等多个领域实现高精度、实时的信号提取。
en_tdlr: TokEye, a reference-free general extractor for coherent time-frequency patterns, achieves high-accuracy, near-real-time signal extraction across fusion diagnostics, marine bioacoustics, and wideband radar without any retraining.
